description:
List the OTHER designs that came out of the same generation as this one. When generate_image is called with concepts > 1, one generation produces a themed set; every design is saved separately and this is how you find its siblings. The design you ask about is never included, and the list is oldest first. An ordinary design returns an empty list, which is the honest answer, not an error (an inaccessible or unknown uuid also reads as empty, so an empty list does not prove the design exists). Read-only and not metered. Each entry carries title and concept_description: the product name and retail description the model wrote for that concept. Use them to build products without asking the merchant to retype copy the model already produced; either may be null and must never be invented. background_state says whether the design can be lifted off its background: transparent is ready to place, opaque_box can be keyed automatically (process_transparency), opaque_varied cannot be separated and will print WITH its background. Asked for a set, the model often answers with pictures of finished garments rather than flat art, and building a product from one prints a garment onto a garment, so do NOT build a product from an opaque_varied design without telling the user it will print with its background. Do not describe it as "a photograph" either: legitimately textured art reports opaque_varied too.

[#f2d543]

design_uuid.description: Any design from the generation (usually the image_uuid generate_image returned).
